thread:
sasha_cs: Heads up — Velora's renewal came in today but procurement flagged missing vendor code and wants PO instead of CC. They asked to pause e-sign until finance confirms the billing entity.
jon_sales: Ugh. Did they give a PO number or vendor template?
sasha_cs: No PO yet. They sent an email saying 'we need vendor code and PO before P.O. generation' and attached their procurement form. I'll paste the relevant fields below.
sasha_cs: ```Vendor required: yes
Billing entity: Velora Holdings Ltd (EU)
Tax ID: -- not provided --
Preferred payment: PO/Net30
```
ellie_fin: Thanks. If billing entity is Velora Holdings Ltd (EU) we need VAT registration or a UK/EU invoice flow. No VAT ID in the form — can we confirm?
sasha_cs: Asked them for VAT and legal name confirmation. Also asked if they can accept our standard e-sign flow if we attach the invoice after signature.
jon_sales: I'm looping in procurement cadence: @procurement-bot can you check vendor code mapping for Velora Holdings Ltd?
procurement-bot: Checked internal vendor list: no exact match for "Velora Holdings Ltd". Closest match is "Velora Systems Inc" (US). Recommend procurement run a vendor onboarding ticket.
nate_legal: If they insist on PO first, we can produce a signed amendment + invoice that references the PO number. Legal prefers executed signature before provisioning but can accept a conditional PO flow if finance approves.
karen_onboarding: Customer is mid-onboarding for SSO and role sync — hold on provisioning will impact their timeline. Any chance to accept a provisional credit or trial extension to keep them alive?
jasha_cs: typo — meant sasha_cs: Good call, @karen_onboarding. I offered a 2-week provisioning hold with service credit if they sign the amendment within 7 days. They replied 'we need vendor code or we can't generate PO.'
ellie_fin: Two paths: 1) Ask them to fast-track vendor onboarding (procurement intake), or 2) accept CC for the initial period and swap to PO on renewal. Which route does sales prefer?
jon_sales: We should avoid losing the seat; propose accepting a single-month CC to unblock onboarding, with a signed amendment that converts to PO/pay terms on next invoice. I'll send the CC override request to my manager for approval.
sasha_cs: Sent sample amendment draft to @nate_legal: included clause that requires customer to provide vendor code and PO within 30 days, else revert to prior billing.
nate_legal: Reviewed and updated the clause to limit financial exposure: added cap language and requirement for PO to reference the amendment ID. Also added: "Vendor onboarding ticket must be created within 5 business days."
john_sales: (typo) — ignore
ellie_fin: If sales gets manager approval for CC override, finance needs: billing contact, provisional CC details, and a note in the invoice metadata: `provisional_payment=true`. Also need their AP contact to route the PO later.
jon_sales: I'll ask for AP contact and the billing contact. Also requesting manager approval now.
sasha_cs: Customer replied with AP contact: ap+velora@velora.com and said they will start vendor onboarding today. They still want PO but will try to expedite.
karen_onboarding: If we get provisional CC approved, I can start SSO and basic onboarding immediately and keep them in a staging org until PO clears.
ellie_fin: Ok — please confirm manager approval in thread. If approved, finance will generate a provisional invoice tagged `provisional` and hold provisioning until the acceptance is logged.
jon_sales: Manager approved CC override for one month. Marking as ACTION: finance provisional invoice. :white_check_mark:
sasha_cs: Filed vendor onboarding ticket with procurement and uploaded customer's procurement form to the ticket. Sent the amendment for e-sign with the provisional clause.
procurement-bot: Vendor onboarding ticket created: #VND-8492. Request ETA from vendor: asked customer to complete onboarding form.
sasha_cs: Customer responded: will complete onboarding form by EOD tomorrow. They also asked if we can e-sign now and have PO appended later.
nate_legal: That's fine as long as amendment contains the PO-appending clause and the cap. Proceed with e-sign.
ellie_fin: Finance confirms — we'll accept provisional CC for initial billing, then apply PO credit when PO arrives referencing invoice/instrument IDs. Need `ap+velora@velora.com` on file.
jon_sales: Great. I'll update the contract status and notify CSM playbook to proceed with onboarding.
sasha_cs: Thanks team — closing the loop: provisioning will start after CC is processed. I'll keep thread updated when PO completes vendor onboarding.
jon_sales: Nice. :thumbsup:
procurement-bot: Reminder scheduled in 7 days to follow up on vendor ticket #VND-8492.
